basic_details.job_title: ZSI Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Zoological Survey of India (ZSI), Kolkata, has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post under an INCOIS sponsored project. The post is purely temporary for two months, with a fellowship of Rs 37,000 plus HRA (according to DST and Central Government norms). The essential qualification is an M.Sc in Zoology / Marine Sciences / Environmental Science / Biophysics and Molecular Biology / Lifesciences with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks, plus two years of research experience in zooplankton studies. Applications go by email to [email protected] on or before 11 November 202

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 28 years as on 30 October 2026. The upper age limit may be relaxed up to five years for SC, ST and OBC candidates (as per GoI rules). | The notice does not list a desirable qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

qualification.details: M.Sc in Zoology / Marine Sciences / Environmental Science / Biophysics and Molecular Biology / Lifesciences with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks from a recognised university. Research experience of a minimum of two years in zooplankton studies. Publications in reputed SCI journals.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the ZSI website, www.zsi.gov.in. The form is also printed on pages 2 and 3 of the notice.
Fill in the form. It asks for name, date of birth, nationality, address, SC/ST/OBC status, qualifications from Matriculation onwards, previous employment, a list of publications and three referees.
Attach a photograph duly signed by the candidate, as the form provides space for it.
Enclose copies of the three best scientific publications and, if the candidate has a Ph.D, a copy of the doctorate degree.
Send the CV along with self-attested copies of certificates to [email protected] on or before 11 November 2026.
Incomplete application forms and applications with misrepresented facts will not be considered. The notice does not name an email subject line.
important_instructions: The Director, Zoological Survey of India reserves the right to reject a candidature for any unforeseen reason, and the decision in selecting the candidate is final. No TA/DA will be paid for the interview. Interview intimation is sent through email, so candidates should write a working email address in the application. Contact: Dr. Jasmine.P, Scientist E, Zoological Survey of India, M Block, New Alipore, Kolkata-700053, West Bengal; mobile +919874983181; email [email protected].

Attach a photograph duly signed by the candidate, as the form provides space for it. Enclose copies of the three best scientific publications and, if the candidate has a Ph.D, a copy of the doctorate degree. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only qualified and suitable candidates will be called for an interview, held at ZSI, Kolkata. Selected candidates for the interview are informed through email. They must register their details at 11:00 AM on the day of the interview at Zoological Survey of India, 'M' Block, New Alipore, Kolkata-700053. The interview date is not specified in the notice. Candidates should bring the duly filled-in application with self-attested true copies of testimonials of qualifications, experience, date of birth, etc., along with copies of mark sheets of all examinations. All original documents should be produced at the time of Online Interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts has ZSI announced?
faq.answer: ZSI has announced one post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under an INCOIS sponsored project, as per Advt. No. 03/ZSI-INCOIS/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ZSI JRF post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by email on or before 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ZSI JRF post?
faq.answer: An M.Sc in Zoology / Marine Sciences / Environmental Science / Biophysics and Molecular Biology / Lifesciences with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks from a recognised university. Two years of research experience in zooplankton studies and publications in reputed SCI journals are also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ZSI JRF post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on 30 October 2026, relaxable up to five years for SC, ST and OBC candidates as per GoI rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the ZSI JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs 37,000/- plus HRA, according to DST and Central Government norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs 37,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states the emoluments as a fellowship of Rs 37,000/- plus HRA, according to DST and Central Government norms.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the ZSI JRF post?
faq.answer: Send your CV along with self-attested copies of certificates to [email protected] on or before 11 November 2026. The application form can be downloaded from www.zsi.gov.in.

faq.question: Q8. How will ZSI select the Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Only qualified and suitable candidates will be called for an interview at ZSI, Kolkata. They are informed through email and register at 11:00 AM on the interview day.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ZSI JRF job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary for two months under the INCOIS sponsored project, and it may be extended based on further extension of the project.

faq.question: Q10. Will ZSI pay travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
